copy.tagline: 用语音或自动化控制你的 Alexa 智能设备
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你拥有 Alexa 设备并想自动化日常任务。
copy.tagline_en: Control your Alexa smart devices with voice or automation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have Alexa devices and want to automate daily tasks.

howto.what: Claude 会指导你如何用 Alexa 控制智能设备、创建例程、设置智能家居，以及开发自定义技能。
howto.when: 当你询问 Alexa 设备控制、例程创建、智能家居设置或技能开发相关问题时触发。

say.text: 如何通过 Alexa 关闭卧室灯？
say.note: Claude 会解释设备命名规则和语音命令。

say.text: 帮我创建一个每天早上7点播报天气的例程。
say.note: Claude 会指导在 Alexa 应用中设置例程。

say.text: 怎么添加智能灯泡到 Alexa？
say.note: Claude 会说明设备发现和分组步骤。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a guide for controlling Alexa devices, creating routines, setting up smart home, and developing custom skills.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about Alexa device control, routine creation, smart home setup, or skill development.

say_en.text: How do I turn off the bedroom light with Alexa?
say_en.note: Claude explains naming conventions and voice commands.

say_en.text: Create a routine to announce weather at 7 AM daily.
say_en.note: Claude guides through the Alexa app routine setup.

say_en.text: How to add a smart bulb to Alexa?
say_en.note: Claude describes device discovery and grouping.
